implementationInterpretations: Guolun any own card means actual Hand/Equipment plus native approved Wooden Ox grain only while formal Wooden Ox is equipped. Judgment and arbitrary piles are excluded. This is a project-native domain interpretation, not a server FAQ claim.

Guolun first chooses a true opaque foreign Hand slot and publicly reveals that exact card. The owner separately may decline; no own material is forced. Both entities relocate atomically to opposite Hands before native equipment removal and all native gain/HP/skill observers drain.

Ranks are frozen with EffectiveOwnedCardRank for the original actual holder before exchange; equal ranks give no draw. The already-paid atomic exchange owes a surviving lower-rank recipient one native draw even if the original skill is removed during a child. A dead recipient is never drawn cards.

Songsang uses real CharacterDied for a different victim, one game usage, a frozen wounded/healthy branch with defined HP. Wounded recovers one through native recovery/replacement; healthy only adds maximum HP, without healing. If owner survives paid health children, acquired Zhanji persists independently of the original source. No future grant is issued to a dead owner.

Zhanji consumes the exact completed NativeDrawInvocation proof only on its real last movement batch, actual owner turn and actual owner Play phase. One whole DrawCards call gives one extra native draw; obtain/gift and normal Draw phase do not qualify. A direct producer with the same owner and printed skill is excluded across skill instances. Public payment facts contain only scalar counts/bounds/source/hash, not unknown gained IDs.
No official FAQ/server grant table was consulted or claimed. Nested combinations are limited to exact native observer permissions and paid invoices, not blanket source-loss/death permission.

Loader alignment: CharacterDied uses its existing owner subject; native collection already visits living owners, and CanOfferSpPangTong proves the real victim differs from this owner. No shared subject permission is widened. Fixture activations serialize explicit usesPerTurn:null with default System.Text.Json settings (no WhenWritingNull option); required optional flags are explicit.

Fourth-run real regression fixed: native rebel-kill DrawCards(3) precedes CharacterDied/Songsang acquisition. Its delayed movement queue must not retroactively gain a new skill subscriber. Only catalogs containing24702 now capture an optional immutable exact enabled Zhanji source/binding/instance/gameplayHash set at the original native invocation start. A count scalar and per-source scalar events prove that snapshot; no card IDs, RNG draw, parallel cache or pending sidecar. Native proof carries frozen entitlements; matching and resumed assertions require original membership. Without24702, field remains null/omitted and no extra facts or sequence IDs are created.
